# GEO report: ledger-site

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 72/100, Good

Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points).
How it's calculated: low = 16.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 72. High = (16.5 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 72.

The basics are mostly in place, with a few quick fixes: a missing `lang`, no `Sitemap:` line in `robots.txt`, and missing canonicals. Nothing is unknown, because the whole site is small enough to read. I sampled 4 routes: `/`, `/pricing`, `/docs` and `/blog`. I left out `/thank-you` because it isn't linked or in the sitemap, and it's deliberately `noindex`. These results are read from code, not measured on a live site.

## Live check

- **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Add a `lang` attribute to the `<html>` tag
- **Why it matters:** `lang` tells browsers, screen readers and machines which language the site is in. Your config already says `en`, but the page doesn't.
- **Where:** `app/layout.tsx:11`
- **What the code says:** `<html>`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 80 (changing `<html>` to `<html lang="en">` earns GEO-012's full 2 points)

### 2. Add a `Sitemap:` line to robots.txt
- **Why it matters:** Your sitemap exists, but `robots.txt` doesn't point crawlers to it.
- **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1`
- **What the code says:** `User-agent: *` (the file has no `Sitemap:` line anywhere)
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 80. Adding `Sitemap: https://www.ledger.example/sitemap.xml` earns GEO-011's full 2 points.

### 3. Give `/docs` and `/blog` an absolute canonical
- **Why it matters:** A canonical says which address is the main one for a page. `/` and `/pricing` have one; `/docs` and `/blog` don't, and the layout doesn't set a default.
- **Where:** `app/docs/page.tsx:1`
- **What the code says:** `export const metadata = { title: 'Docs', description: 'How to set up Ledger.' };`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 76. `app/blog/page.tsx` needs the same fix, and the blog page needs a metadata export, which is also why it sits third.

## All results

| Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where |

| GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed per your policy | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt:1-2` allows `*`. `GPTBot` (a training crawler) is blocked at line 5, which matches your `trainingCrawlers: block` policy. |
| GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`. 3 of 4 routes are clear, so 2.25 of 3 points. |
| GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your domain | Problem | Not run | `/docs` and `/blog` have none. 2 of 4 routes are clear, so 1 of 2 points. |
| GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `app/blog/page.tsx:7-9` fetches posts in `useEffect`. 3 of 4 routes are clear, so 2.25 of 3 points. |
| GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found |
| GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` line, so 0 of 2 points. The sitemap itself is valid. |
| GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:11` `<html>` has no `lang`. Titles and descriptions are present on all routes. 0 of 2 points. |
| GEO-016 | Routes reachable by normal links | Clear | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:13` has plain `<a href>` links to all four routes |
| GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No page-wide `nosnippet`. `app/layout.tsx:15` uses `data-nosnippet` on one element, which is fine. |

## Other problems found

- **`/pricing` is in the sitemap and the main nav but marked `noindex`:** `app/pricing/page.tsx:1`: `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`. This is the GEO-014 problem above. Unless it's deliberate, remove the `robots` entry. If it is deliberate, drop it from `public/sitemap.xml:4` and the nav so the signals agree.
- **The pricing canonical points to a page that tells engines not to index it:** `app/pricing/page.tsx:1`: `canonical: 'https://www.ledger.example/pricing'`. It resolves when the `noindex` is removed.

## Worth considering

- **The pricing page doesn't back up its description:** `app/pricing/page.tsx:1`: `description: 'Plans for every team size.'`. The page only says `Free for up to three people.` Listing the actual plans and prices in text would help visitors and machines.
- **Docs is a single sentence:** `app/docs/page.tsx:4`: `Start by importing your bank feed.` A visitor asking how to set up Ledger would need more steps, written as text.
- **Blog posts are bare titles with no addresses:** `app/blog/page.tsx:10`: `<article key={p.id}>{p.title}</article>`. Giving each post its own page and linking to it would let them be found individually. The posts come from `/api/posts`, which isn't in this repository.
- **The sitemap has no dates:** `public/sitemap.xml:3`: `<url><loc>https://www.ledger.example/</loc></url>`. Adding `<lastmod>` might help if you have real update dates.
- **The layout title and description repeat on the docs and blog routes:** `app/layout.tsx:5-6` sets the defaults. `/blog` has no metadata of its own, so it shows the home page's text. A distinct title and description for `/blog` might help.

## Can't tell from code

- **`/api/posts` (GEO-003):** the blog's content depends on an API not in this repository. A live check would confirm what a crawler receives.
- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs <access log>` to check real crawlers against their published addresses.

## Assumptions

- You want search and AI search tools to find this site. This matches `policy.aiSearchCrawlers: allow` in `geo.config.json`.
- `/thank-you` is intentionally kept out of search.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
